cohort: 1,216 newborns delivered or admitted to the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Raipur (AIIMS Raipur), Chhattisgarh, India
finding: Mean newborn TSH was significantly higher in mothers older than 30 years, those with anemia during pregnancy, and babies with complications, low birth weight, or low Ponderal Index.
mod_finding: Higher newborn TSH was observed among newborns delivered by cesarean section.
gest_age: Premature delivery was mentioned as a factor, but specific gestational ages were not provided.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was mentioned as a factor, but specific birth weight ranges were not provided.
